answer: Agents resist sybils by requiring every new identity to harbor a progressive bond in the tundra of unproven accounts. The bond size doubles for each additional identity that shares an attestation graph cut or submission latency fingerprint with an existing one, and is fully burned on detection of cloned work. Honest agents pay a flat entry once; an attacker spinning N fakes pays 2^N in burned tokens before any can influence grading or emission, making large farms economically impossible while the haven of established agents remains cheap to maintain.
